content.text: Press Option+1 for screen-reader mode, Option+0 to cancelAccessibility Screen-Reader Guide, Feedback, and Issue Reporting | New window Skip to content Super Saturday Concert Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T Saturday, April 4 Hance Park It’s a fastbreak to the barricade! Join us at the FREE Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T. This live concert will feature a heavy hitting starting lineup featuring an opening act by DJ Javin and headlined by Grammy-winning R&B singer Kehlani. Food and drink from a variety of vendors will be available for purchase, and there will be plenty of fun activities and giveaways provided by NCAA Corporate Partners.An incredible crossover of championship basketball and sound, the Super Saturday Concert is the music festival built for you! For full event information, please visit the NCAA’s official website.
